quest.title: Dune-Entombed Fecundity: Part II
quest.description: You run into Azariq in the desert and find yourself invited to accept his help in making your way to the next location...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x450, Primogem x50, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

talks.objective: Go to the place Azariq mentioned

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Look, this is it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! It's huge...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Hmph! This kind of scrap can be dug up everywhere in the desert. Why did you ask us to come here specifically? Are we gonna play at war inside or something?

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Be patient, little wildcat. This one's interior is in perfect condition! We can activate it and use it to cross those dangerous quicksand-filled areas!

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: Hmph... A tribesman who knows the inner workings of machinery? An eye-opener, to be sure.

choices.text: Azariq, how do you know how to activate it?

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: The blueprints Aderfi left behind recorded the mechanical structure of this thing. It wasn't difficult to understand that structure with the basic knowledge that I have.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: Maybe those northerners from the snowy lands gave it to him in a trade... Who knows what he would've wanted this for, though...

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: #C'mon, I'm here to help! {NICKNAME}, you're a knowledgeable sort. You must have seen this sort of machine before, right?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It does look fascinating, but I can't say I understand how it works...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we've seen lots of Ruin Guards before, but an iron ball of this sort and size... Hmm, Paimon really has no idea what it would be for.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: I've seen similar machines in the desert before as well. But this is the first time I've seen one that's this intact.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: Huh... Interesting. Let's just go in through its arm first, shall we?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Azariq, you knew all these things... But you never once told me about them.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: *sigh* Don't get mad at me, little wildcat.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: Relax. You know I won't hide anything from you! I'll tell you the full story once this journey is over.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Dad once said that these are war machines left over from 500 years ago... I can't help but wonder what actually happened in that era...

response.speaker: Paimon

response.text: From 500 years ago? Interesting... Almost all records of that period have been destroyed, insofar as I've read.

choices.text: You could put it like that...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, Paimon can't quite explain it... Anyway, it was a long, long time ago!

response.speaker: Paimon

talks.objective: Open the cabin door and go inside

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: If the blueprint is correct, the generator room should be down there. We need to activate the power system first before we can activate this big guy.

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, sorry to trouble you again. After confirming that the energy system has been activated, let's all head to the control cabin.

talks.objective: Activate the giant machine's energy system

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: *huff* Let me see... Energy system, looks fine; engine, fine; weapons... the long-range sub-weapon is out of order, the main one isn't functioning normally; melee weapons and left arm, working...

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Hmm, it all looks pretty good, to be honest!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Jeht, what's wrong? You look like something's on your mind...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: N—No, it's nothing... It's just that I didn't get even half of what he said just now...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Azariq feels like a different person. I've never seen him like this before...

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: What? I've become more reliable, haven't I? Hahaha.

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Autopilot... autopilot... Hmm, looks like it's been dismantled. Can't find that device at all...

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Sorry, it seems that we'll have to operate this big guy by ourselves.

choices.text: You mean I have to, don't you?

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: Worry not, my master. I shall guide you from the side.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: Oh, so you know the way?

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: Of course I do. I can sense the vibrations of my fragments, after all.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: Well, guess we'll be troubling you to show us the way, then. Let's start this machine in the meantime, shall we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoaaa!

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: It's incredible to think that such a giant thing can even move...

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: #What's the matter, {NICKNAME}? According to the blueprint, the generator room should be right down there. We must activate its energy system first, and I'll leave that to you.

talks.objective: Check on the condition of the machine's interior
Discuss what to do with Azariq and the others

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Ugh... If only Aderfi were here...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: He's a traitor to the tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: But he was also the only one who could figure out how this thing works.

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Please allow me some time to focus here... Aderfi did leave those blueprints behind... I just need to recall what those illustrations looked like.

choices.text: With an arm so massive, the amount of energy it consumes must be absurd...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, Paimon wonders how much stuff it has to eat to work normally... Hmm. Maybe it can't move anymore because it's been hungry for too long!

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: There should be a backup power source for the weapon system on each side of the control cabin.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: The imitations they made all had this structure, so perhaps this old one will be no exception either.

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: "They"? Who's "they"?

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: You are interested in your own fragments, and Jeht is interested in the Eternal Oasis. Never mind who "they" are for now, would you?

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: Fair enough. I shall ask again later.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: ...Sorry, Jeht. I know I'm being a bit impatient...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, that could be it! Still, how do you know this kind of stuff, anyway...

talks.objective: Restore power to the left arm

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: What's the matter? Can't find the backup power sources?

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: They should be somewhere on either side of the control cabin. Once you find one of the mechanisms, trigger it and the energy system should reactivate.

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: I certainly hope that the blueprint Aderfi left behind is reliable enough...

talks.objective: Go back to the control room and open the passage

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Now you just need to operate it to open the passage.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And why don't you operate it yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: W—Well... There are just some things that have more... ceremony, when you do them.

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Whoa...! *huff* Did anyone fall and hurt themselves?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! Are you alright?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whew, guess none of us were hurt then!

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: We can enter that opening through the passage inside the arm now.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: We should leave some people here to stand guard while the rest of us move on.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Wait, don't you care about the "taboo" anymore?

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: Eh, I care more about your safety.

talks.objective: Enter the cave through the ancient machine's arm
Enter the cave through the ancient machine's arm
Enter the cave through the ancient machine's arm

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Hmm... The gate here is closed, and there seems to be no other way.

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: There may be clues to open the gate around here. Let's all keep our eyes peeled.

talks.objective: Look for the passage to proceed

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Looks like we'll need to open that gate up there next. As per our previous experience, the pipelines here will probably have to be connected to let the quicksand drive the gate.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: But the mechanisms next to the pipes seem completely broken...

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Then we can only see if there's any way to connect the pipes in other places. Hmm... The pipes are supposed to connect the two sides, right? If the mechanism that controls the gate is on one side, then the other side...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon thinks it should lead to that room over there!

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Alright, let's go and see what's in there first.

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Well? Do you want to explore here some more or go back to that big iron ball?

choices.text: (Return to the surface) Let's go back.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: Alright! Jeht, time to go!

choices.text: I'd like to explore here some more.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: *sigh* Oh, the curiosity... But, as you wish.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As the shard of light merges with Liloupar's magic bottle, you feel a little of your own power being pulled away...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Through the Jinni's entranced eyes, you see a ravenous shepherd boy and a bright red pomegranate...\nYou see the pomegranate juice flowing freely, like the wine of tyrants, the infatuation of lovers, and the fresh blood of innocent victims...\nYou see the plump pomegranate being handed to the shepherd boy...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Take a bite and use it to quench your thirst. But be careful not to let it burst in your hands..."

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, are you okay...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You suddenly froze up again, and you wouldn't respond to anyone... You really scared us there!

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: #Do not fret, {M#he}{F#she} is fine.

choices.text: Don't worry, Jeht. I just zoned out for a bit.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Phew, okay... Stop scaring us like that, though!

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: My apologies if my troubled memories bothered you. But thanks to your help, my power has been restored... partly, in any case.

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: Pomegranates... Ah, pomegranates... The sweet fruit made from the congealed blood of the victimized... Should I have the chance to share it with you, my master, I surely will.

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: How I desire to see the plump arils burst between your teeth, and how the rich juice overflows from your lips...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... That does sound delicious, but Paimon doesn't think she's talking about fruit...

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Ahem, we should go. There're still many mechanisms waiting for us ahead.

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: Now, now, little girl, are you sulking again?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: I'm not! I just said we should go!

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: Careful, the little wildcat is about to bite.

choices.text: Don't worry, Paimon. I'll be fine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, fine, if you say so! Jeht was also really worried about you, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, have you found anything?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not yet! What about you?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Not really... But I think we just need to move along the walls as we search.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: ...What about him?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Well... I know you may have doubts about him, but he's Matriarch Babel's most trusted subordinate, so it does us no good being suspicious all the time.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: That said, he does know a little too much, which makes me uneasy... But that's just a gut feeling, you know?

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: Ah, but intuition can be quite accurate sometimes...

talks.objective: Go to the deepest part of Mt. Damavand
Talk to Jeht and the others

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Alright... Now it looks like there's only one passage left for us to open.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? There's more!? Paimon's legs are already sore!

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Oh? And you know this because you walk on your own two feet?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Uh... Nah! Paimon was just, uh, speaking for {NICKNAME}! Yeah! Y—You must be tired, right?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: #Haha, {NICKNAME} is a veteran adventurer after all. You'd better exercise more, or {M#he'll}{F#she'll} leave you behind sooner or later.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #N—No way! {NICKNAME} will definitely wait for Paimon, no matter what...

response.speaker: Liloupar
response.text: Hmm... My memory is gradually coming together. I can now guide you to the next location.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #See? What did Paimon tell you? We've walked for so long that even {NICKNAME}'s tired!

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: #Hahaha! {M#He}{F#She} was just messing with you. This much walking is hardly a challenge for a veteran adventurer, you know?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: But if you're really so tired, Paimon, why don't you let me carry you around? Hehehe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: N—No need! That would just be embarrassing...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, are we leaving now?

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Alright! Azariq, time to go!

choices.text: I'd like to stay here a little longer.

response.speaker: Jeht
response.text: Please be careful. We'll wait for you here.

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: There should be a mechanism around here that can help open the gate. Let's all keep our eyes peeled.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: It's completely normal. Like I said, I have many friends on the outside and I've learned a lot from them... Don't you underestimate us tribespeople, alright?

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: Hmm... If I were you, I'd start from those pipelines. After all, that's the one thing we've no shortage of.

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Look, this is it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! It's huge...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Hmph! This kind of scrap can be dug up everywhere in the desert. Why did you ask us to come here specifically? Are we gonna play at war inside or something?

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: *sigh* Don't get mad at me, little wildcat.

response.speaker: Azariq
response.text: Relax. You know I won't hide anything from you! I'll tell you the full story once this journey is over.

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: This fellow's actions are quite suspicious... not to mention overeager...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Azariq... No, it's nothing...

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Wow... So this iron ball could make such a huge hole...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's more like a rift than the entrance to a cave...

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: If we can bring this thing back to the tribe, it will definitely be of great use.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: And what would you do, take Matriarch Babel out for a joyride?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Hey, check this out! I've never seen flowers like these before... They're so beautiful, but it's kinda unsettling for them to appear like this in the desert.

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: These flowers belong to the mistress... After she fell into a deep slumber, they were said to have disappeared into the desert... I didn't expect to see them again here...

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: At least this shows that there must be an environment deep in this cave that allows plant roots to absorb nutrients.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, look, the door over there seems just about ready to open! W—Well... Paimon's intuition says so, anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The door's unlocked!

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: I can feel my fragment calling to me. It is just up ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: What a long tunnel... And those same strange flowers we saw earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: This place used to be the mistress's greenhouse, but now, perhaps only these flowers survive.

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: Fascinating... Were these tunnels excavated by humans? I didn't see any steps or paved paths... Everything seems to have been shaped naturally.

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: Perhaps they have all been weathered away... Or perhaps the builders never thought of leaving too many traces of artifice in passages of this kind?

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: This was once a sacred place, inaccessible to all save the priests... Or so my broken memories tell, should they serve me correctly.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There were red crystals in the first tunnel, and this one has all these large purple flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: Well, have you noticed? "The Three Eternal Companion-Gods" — that's who this oasis commemorates.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh...?

dialogues.speaker: Jeht
dialogues.text: So the one in whom we Tanit place our faith... Nabu Malikata...

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: That's my mistress, yes. Now show some respect, little lass.

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: She slumbers in the Eternal Oasis. This tunnel was dug in her memory.

dialogues.speaker: Azariq
dialogues.text: So the relationship between Gurabad and this place...

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: The Lord charged the mortals' ideal kingdom with guarding his Eternal Oasis. That is why there was a city on the periphery of this dune.

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: But the city of Gurabad fell into a gap in the sand, and became shrouded by death and oblivion... Well, that's another story.

dialogues.speaker: Liloupar
dialogues.text: It's the fragment... It is just up ahead, my master!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But it hasn't been turned on in quite a while, has it? That might cause some problems...
